title: 2023 Select Numbers Travis Etienne Jacksonville Jaguars Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This Travis Etienne Jr. trading card is a must-have for any Jacksonville Jaguars fan or collector. With the Numbers parallel/variety, this 2023 Select card features the running back in his Jaguars uniform. The card is made of high-quality card stock and is an original, licensed reprint.

Measuring at standard size, this football trading card is an insert in the 2023 Select set. It is not autographed, but it is a great addition to any collection. Whether you are a longtime collector or just starting out, this card is a perfect fit for your collection. Get your hands on this card today and add it to your Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop collection.
